title: Welcome to Sol Central: 1,000 cr once; 15 iron ore mined at Lacaille 9352 Deep Vein (2 jumps), handed in at Sol Central
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 23:13 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6: newborns do their class's work where they were born, their empire's missions first; rules F34, F35, F37). Every Solarian miner of the birth wave holds the starter mission 'Welcome to Sol Central' (mine 15 iron ore, 1,000 cr; its live file of 22:44 UTC: current 0 of 15). Sol's Main Belt reads 2 iron of 100,000 (census 11 h old); Lacaille 9352 Deep Vein read 4,791 iron (richness 30), 2 jumps by Sirius, Solarian policed space (table fields, systems). The first stop stores the starter cargo (argon gas, patches) so the hold is free; the last hands the mission in and stores the ore. Only in the rows of Solarian-born miners, never in First or a template: a Voidborn pilot holds no such mission. max_ships 3: each pilot's own mission, 45 units drawn from a field of 4,791 (under 1%), so the three runs share no buyer and do not contend for the field (F37).
